source_fps_note: FPS is not recorded in the source HDF5; 30 FPS is only a nominal playback rate, so no real-time durations are claimed.
selection_reason: The episode is one continuous pick-and-place task (grasp strawberry, carry to bowl, release, withdraw) with no independent subtasks, so the complete sequence is retained and no shortened branch or separate full-sequence prompt is made.
usable_prompt: The robotic arm grasps the red strawberry from the table, carries it over the pink bowl, and releases it into the bowl, then lifts clear. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
full_sequence_prompt: The robotic arm grasps the red strawberry from the table, carries it over the pink bowl, and releases it into the bowl, then lifts clear. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

selected_action_outcome.description: The gripper closes on the strawberry on the table (about frames 30-62), lifts it (about 90-96), carries it left to above the pink bowl (about 96-104), lowers it into the bowl and opens (about 106-124), and the arm rises clear (about 120-133). The red strawberry is visible resting in the bowl at the last frame.

source_overall_outcome.description: Same as the selected action: strawberry ends inside the pink bowl, arm raised back near its starting pose, gripper open.

anatomical_side_evidence.visible_description: Single Franka Emika Panda arm with a parallel-jaw gripper; base off-frame at image left, the arm enters from the left edge in the camera_right view. Only one arm exists.
anatomical_side_evidence.source_annotation: original/task_prompt.txt and language_raw: 'pick up strawberry in bowl'.
anatomical_side_evidence.visual_certainty: Not a humanoid; left/right anatomy not needed. The prompt refers to the single visible robotic arm.

arm_roles.active_visible_arm: Single arm grasps the strawberry, carries it to the bowl, releases it, and withdraws upward.

coordination: Single arm acts alone; no second arm, hand transfer or human interaction.

chronology.observation: Arm held above the table at image left with gripper open and pointing down; pink bowl at image left of centre and red strawberry to its right, both on the white table.
Arm swings forward/right and lowers the open gripper onto the strawberry (blue wrist light visible).
Gripper closes around the strawberry on the table (telemetry gripper value rises from about 0.02 at frame 30 to about 0.2 at frame 60); the strawberry stays on the table.
Gripper holds the strawberry at the table with small adjustments; gripper value reaches about 0.55 by frame 84.
Strawberry lifted off the table and carried left and slightly toward the bowl, positioned above the bowl rim by about frame 100.
Gripper lowers the strawberry into the bowl and opens (gripper value falls from about 0.5 at frame 108 to 0.13 at frame 120 and 0 by 126); strawberry rests in the bowl.
Arm rises and moves back up and to image left toward the start pose with the gripper open; strawberry remains in the pink bowl.

uncertainties: Whether the strawberry is lifted slightly before frame 92 is hard to judge at this resolution; frames 34-90 show the gripper at the strawberry with the berry still near the table, and the lift is clearest from frame 92.
The exact release frame inside the bowl (about 110-120) is inferred from the gripper telemetry and the opening fingers, partly occluded by the bowl rim.
FPS is not recorded in the source; frame indices are authoritative, not time.
Gripper telemetry polarity (higher value = more closed) was inferred from the video and used only as supporting evidence.
source_annotation_discrepancies: The publisher instruction 'pick up strawberry in bowl' is ambiguous; the video shows the strawberry being picked from the table and placed into the pink bowl, which the prompt reflects. No object colour or side discrepancies.

inspection_coverage.sampling_method: Every second decoded frame of camera_right (frames 0-132) in sequential temporary contact sheets, plus native-resolution frames 34, 62, 92, 106, 114 and the final frame 133.
inspection_coverage.telemetry_used: puppet/joint_position gripper column (index 7) sampled every 6 frames as supporting evidence only.
